name: Octree-based 3D Voxelization with SAT Pruning
aliases: Octree-based 3D Voxelization with SAT Pruning — Divide-and-Conquer Spatial Partitioning, Recursive Octree Voxelizer
definition: A method that converts arbitrary 3D triangular surface meshes into uniform voxel representations by recursively partitioning space into an Octree and using the Separating Axis Theorem (SAT) to prune empty bounding volumes.
summary: Octree-based 3D Voxelization with SAT Pruning converts triangular meshes into voxel representations by recursively partitioning space and using the Separating Axis Theorem to prune empty volumes for robustness and performance.
